title: LoCoMo
domain: Very long-term conversational memory over conversations of 19 to 32 sessions.
good_to_know: Each conversation is one task, with its questions inside. The smallest run is one conversation.
The score is the mean token F1 over the questions, as in the paper. There is no pass or fail.
What goes into the memory is an option: the conversation itself by default, or the authors' released facts or session summaries.
upstream_limitations: The 446 adversarial questions are left out, because the published file has no answer for them. 1,540 of the 1,986 questions remain.
The reader's model name must contain gpt-4 or gpt-3.5, as LoCoMo's own code requires. Any other model fails every question.
The paper's readers, gpt-4-turbo and gpt-3.5-turbo, now point to newer models. Scores can differ from the paper's for that reason.
The reader gets 32 tokens per answer. A reasoning model can spend them all reasoning, and that question fails.
One unreadable reply stops the whole conversation, because LoCoMo's script writes its answers only at the end.
Original memory runs the paper's retrieval setup and needs a CUDA GPU. It writes facts and summaries anew each run, so they differ from the authors' released ones.
Contriever, LoCoMo's default retriever, and the OpenAI retriever fail as published. DRAGON and DPR run, DRAGON by default.
limitations: The paper's other readers are not offered. Claude 3 Sonnet and Gemini Pro 1.0 are retired, and the Llama 3 and Mistral readers run only as local weights.

datasets.title: LoCoMo-10
datasets.verifier: LoCoMo's own task_eval/evaluate_qa.py: the token F1 of each answer against the reference; no judge model.
